_meta.notes: TIER 1 — raw ND-GAIN release, latest year 2024. Annual climate vulnerability + readiness scores per country. Vulnerability: 0-1, higher = more vulnerable (NOT inverted). Readiness: 0-1, higher = more resilient. ND-GAIN composite: 0-100, higher = better adapted. Food sector sub-score (food_vulnerability) directly feeds the FDRS climate component. Covered 192 countries (per-metric: {'gain_index': 190, 'vulnerability': 190, 'readiness': 192, 'food_vulnerability': 189}). Source refreshes annually (typically Q3/Q4); pipeline runs every 6h but data rarely changes between releases.
